about: D-124 addendum (2026-10-09): edge time per driver pin for the reference-plane detour budget of tools/si_planes.py (tools/net_drivers.py reads this file). A net's edge is the shortest edge of its drivers, found in the schematic netlist. Roles: input (not a driver), push_pull (edge = min(tr, tf)), open_drain (open drain or open collector with a pull-up: edge = tf, the driver's fall; the RC rise is slower), opto (phototransistor output: min(tr, tf)), unknown (no published edge time: the net fails as 'unknown driver'). Statistic: the smallest value the document publishes (min, else typ, else max: then noted 'max only'). Each value: document, table, page, URL, [P] primary source read. Never a default: a part or pin with no rule is unknown.

pins.load: VCE = 10 V, IC = 2 mA, RL = 100 ohm, f = 100 Hz

TI TPS3828 datasheet: no RESET output rise or fall time
